sara: Onboarding 'orionx-7b' (llama-format) -> quant/int4: short tests look fine but we see attention drift when resuming long contexts after a checkpoint restore (repeat loops after 800 tokens). suspect positional offset or rotary phase mismatch.

noah: which conversion path? llama->redwood converter v1.2.0? any rotary reparam step?

sara: yes converter v1.2.0, enabled 'rotary-adapt' flag. quick repro in eval harness included.

devon: try toggling rotary-adapt off and see if repeat goes away. also run tokenizer parity against reference tokenizer for 1k+ doc.

sara: did that: rotary-adapt off reduces repeats significantly (ppl 42 -> 16). tokenizer parity shows identical token stream. so conversion rotary adapt likely introduced a phase offset.

onboard-bot: repro machine spun up: ded-orion-02, job 17856321.

noah: OK next steps: revert rotary-adapt, compute phase_offset by fitting rotary matrices to original checkpoint (small least squares), then validate across head groups. no per-head random tweaks.

devon: open PR to add 'resume-context' test in onboarding suite to catch restore-time repeats. also add a flag that disables rotary-adapt by default until validated.

sara: filing issue and PR now. will re-run long-run after patch.
